name: smwgraphics-uwu-tree
title: "UwU" Tree
description:
Have you ever seen those big tree's from "Forest of Illusion" and thinked that it looked like an OwO face?, well, probably you didn't, but whatever...

This simple modification makes the big tree have an "UwU" face instead of an "OwO" one, good for meme hacks or a cute/pink overworld style's.
